hero.title: Tomi Abe is a builder and strategist.
hero.description: I work with organizations to turn complex systems into clear products, brands, stories, and useful experiences.

introduction.title: A one-person practice with a wide operating range.
introduction.text: Tomi Abe Studio brings strategy, design, technology, and communication into the same room. The work can begin with a product, a brand, a data problem, or a stuck decision. It ends with a clearer system that people can use, understand, and carry forward.

approach.title: How the practice moves
approach.description: The shape of the work changes. The underlying approach stays deliberate, collaborative, and close to the real problem.

practice.title: Built for useful change.
practice.description: The studio is independent by design. You work directly with Tomi from the first conversation through the work that follows.

process.title: Frame the real problem
process.description: Find the constraints, the missing context, and the decision that will make the rest of the work move.

process.title: Shape the system
process.description: Give the product, brand, platform, or story a structure that people can understand and use.

process.title: Make it real
process.description: Move from direction into working design, content, prototypes, code, and the details that make it hold.

process.title: Leave it stronger
process.description: Build enough clarity, documentation, and confidence for the work to continue without unnecessary dependence.

operatingModels.title: Ways to work together.
operatingModels.description: The relationship can be advisory, hands-on, or embedded. The useful part is choosing the shape that matches the problem and the team.

profile.title: Tomi works where ideas need both direction and form.
profile.body:
His work spans strategy, product design, brand systems, creative technology, data storytelling, and implementation. That range is intentional. Complex problems rarely arrive in a single discipline, so the practice is designed to connect the parts that are usually separated.

Alongside client work, Tomi speaks, trains, and mentors on design, emerging technology, systems thinking, and responsible innovation.
